nodes.label: Frontend Fix Plan v2
nodes.rationale: Re-audit after v1 fixes introduced three new regressions more severe than the originals; documents what changed while v1 remains the backlog.

nodes.label: Missing CSS Brace Regression
nodes.rationale: One missing '}' in .sr-only made CSS error recovery swallow ~22k characters, dropping ~95% of the site stylesheet; verified with tinycss2 rather than guessed.

nodes.label: JSX Syntax in Plain HTML Regression
nodes.rationale: className/onClick/style={{}} are not browser features in a static HTML file; they left the theme toggle inert and threw TypeError on every login.html load.
